pub fn router(state: AppState) -> Router {
    let files = ServeDir::new(&state.config.web_dir).not_found_service(ServeFile::new(format!(
        "{}/index.html",
        state.config.web_dir
    )));
    Router::new()
        .route("/healthz", get(|| async { "ok" }))
        .route(
            "/readyz",
            get(|State(s): State<AppState>| async move {
                if s.worker.snapshots.borrow().link == "healthy" {
                    StatusCode::OK
                } else {
                    StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
                }
            }),
        )
        .route("/auth/github", get(login))
        .route("/auth/callback", get(callback))
        .route("/auth/dev", get(dev))
        .route("/api/v1/me", get(me))
        .route("/api/v1/logout", post(logout))
        .route("/api/v1/config", get(config))
        .route("/api/v1/fleet", get(snapshot))
        .route("/api/v1/events", get(events))
        .route("/api/v1/control", post(claim).delete(release))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/waypoints", post(waypoint))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/cancel", post(cancel))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/drive", post(drive))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/stop", post(emergency_stop))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/hardware", post(hardware))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/autonomy", post(autonomy))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/occupancy", get(occupancy))
        .route("/api/v1/rovers/{id}/navigation", post(navigation))
        .route("/api/v1/operations/{id}", get(operation))
        .route(
            "/api/{*path}",
            get(|| async { StatusCode::NOT_FOUND }).post(|| async { StatusCode::NOT_FOUND }),
        )
        .fallback_service(files)
        .layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(4096))
        .layer(TraceLayer::new_for_http().make_span_with(|request: &axum::http::Request<Body>| tracing::info_span!("http",method=%request.method(),path=%request.uri().path())))
        .layer(middleware::from_fn(security_headers))
        .with_state(state)
}

Rejects invalid parameters, re-checks eligibility after the audit write, then calls Fleet::navigation.

The thread spawned inside connect_authenticated, not a second function. Every 50 ms, if held keys still have drive authority, it puts {prefix}/{id}/teleop. Losing authority puts a zero.

Writes the held-key set for one rover. Switching rovers puts a zero teleop on the previous id. The teleop thread reads this set.
Rejects an empty prefix and any *, ?, #, $, or space. goal, fleet, statuses, and depth build {prefix}/{id}/goal, {prefix}/fleet/state, {prefix}/*/goal/status, and {prefix}/*/camera/depth.
JSON for a local or wgs84 goal plus the token. Local values must sit inside ±20000 m. The body must be at most 2048 bytes.
Parses FleetState and rejects duplicate ids or more than 4096 ids.
Parses GoalStatus. Idle must have goal_id 0. Distance, x, and y must be finite. A token must pass valid_token.
Splits a depth packet on the first newline and reads the JSON header. Pixels are not decoded. Missing body yields None.
Parses a pose object with rover_id, sequence, x, y, and yaw. This is the phone pose topic, not the depth header.
Requires schema_version 1, at most 250000 cells, and cell values in −1..=100.
Stores membership and keeps at most 32 retired ids. A new id resets that rover's entry.
Ignores a rover that is not a member. A matching token moves the command phase to active, arrived, or superseded. Idle while cancelling becomes cancelled.
Stores the pose only when the rover is a current member and pose.rover_id matches the key.
Sets link to disconnected, connecting, stale, or healthy from fleet age against the 90 second supervision horizon. A pending command older than 150 seconds becomes unconfirmed.
Refuses a stale or absent rover and a command that is still pending inside the 150 second ack window. On success the phase is pending and the bytes come from GoalRequest::encode.
Same freshness check as prepare_goal. Sets the phase to cancelling and clears the token.
Handles autonomy/status, goal/proposal, mission/status, and experiment/status. A new run id resets the entry. An older authority revision is ignored.
JSON per rover: status, age, proposal, mission, experiment, and the pending action phase. A pending action older than 2 seconds is unconfirmed.
Checks an Apple action body for autonomy, safety, goal/decision, or mission/report, then adds the token. Extra fields are rejected.
If the heartbeat run id and sequence match the cached grid, the cache timestamp is refreshed. The cells are not replaced.
Same match for a point cloud: version, frameID, and sequence. Only the receive time moves.

path.why: Process entry. Config, the database, and the HTTP router are reached from this function.
The Zenoh endpoint and the terra/rover prefix are fixed here, before a key is built.
The session and every subscriber are installed in this function. Samples do not enter anywhere else.
A goal/status payload is accepted or dropped here, before it can change a command phase.
An accepted status is matched to the outstanding token and stored on the rover.
Pose, goal, authority, hardware, and localization are copied into the server FleetSnapshot in this function.
This thread is where a command runs and where the snapshot watch is replaced.
The watch value leaves as an SSE event named fleet.
That event becomes the React state the maps read.
A browser mutation passes the session, origin, CSRF, and role checks here, then the worker channel.
A waypoint is not put from submit. tick is the function that calls send_goal, once, after the mode token matches.
session.put writes {prefix}/{id}/goal. That is the waypoint leaving the process.
